2607.23519.title: Auditing Alignment Controllability in LLMs via Political Axes
2607.23519.paper_summary: Political audits of large language models (LLMs) usually reduce each to one point on a political compass. But that resting point barely matters in deployment: a model must land somewhere, and what counts is how far, and in which directions, its answers can be steered. That steering runs through the system prompt: the personalization layer a platform sets, or one induced from a user's history, not necessarily written by hand. We run a dispersion-first stress test of prompt-based controllability across 12 ideological personas plus an unsteered baseline, 70 Political Compass items, ten replicates, and seven leading LLMs: GPT-5, Claude, Grok, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, and Qwen (63,700 responses). Contextual framing explains roughly 88%-93% of variance on the economic and society axes, model identity under 3%: responses are highly instruction-adjustable. Models do not shift alike: some move more, and some saturate under extreme framings. Conflicting directional-steering results in prior audits resolve once baselines are recognized as non-centered: displacement and proximity diverge, so the effect is geometric, not differential compliance. Under authoritarian prompts, models produce similar shifts on the same questions. Political-coordinate audits therefore need steerability audits reporting dispersion, symmetry, saturation, and refusal floors. We release prompts, benchmark data, and code.
2607.23519.paper_summary_zh: 政治審計大型語言模型（LLMs）通常將每個模型簡化為政治羅盤上的一個點。<lb/>但這個靜止點在部署中幾乎無關緊要：模型必須落在某個地方，而重要的是它的回答可以被引導多遠，以及朝哪個方向。<lb/>這種引導通過系統提示進行：平台設置的個性化層，或基於用戶歷史的引導，並不一定是手動編寫的。<lb/>我們對基於提示的可控性進行了一次以分散為首的壓力測試，涵蓋12個意識形態角色加上一個未引導的基線，70個政治羅盤項目，十次重複測試，以及七個主要的LLMs：GPT-5、Claude、Grok、Gemini、DeepSeek、Kimi和Qwen（63,700個回應）。<lb/>上下文框架解釋了經濟和社會軸上約88%-93%的變異，模型身份則低於3%：回應高度可調整。<lb/>模型的變化並不相同：有些模型的變化更大，而有些在極端框架下會飽和。<lb/>先前審計中相互矛盾的方向性引導結果在基線被認識為非中心化後得到解決：位移和接近度分歧，因此效果是幾何的，而不是差異性合規。<lb/>在威權主義提示下，模型在相同問題上產生類似的變化。<lb/>因此，政治坐標審計需要可引導性審計，報告分散性、對稱性、飽和度和拒絕底線。<lb/>我們發布了提示、基準數據和代碼。
